mod.name: Just Enough Resources (JER)
mod.summary: A JEI addon that adds mob drops, ore gen, ..

description:
This is the successor of NotEnoughResources.

 

Bleeding edge builds are the ones tagged as alpha (basically whenever I commit something to the repo).

Fabric version available as of MC 1.19 and up.

 

 Features:

  • Mob Drops



  • Dungeon Loot



  • Ore Gen



  • Plant Drops

  • DIY ore graphs

By adding world-gen.json to the JER config folder and toggling the DIY setting ingame you can make your own ore distributions.

See github wiki for info on how to generate this using a JER command.

For 1.12+ take a look at RegionScanner to generate the json file.
